notes:
- STATS screen in the main menu: your lifetime totals (kills, headshots, melee kills, Sir Chonks
  defeated, Screamers silenced, Seal Launcher kills, trap kills, box spins, perks, upgrades, rounds, games).
- Records for every map: best round, best score and games played. The game-over screen tells you when
  you set a new personal best on that map, or shows the best to beat.
- 14 challenges with progress bars and XP rewards, from First Blood (100 kills) to Legend (round 30).
  A banner pops up in game the moment you complete one.
- New launcher look: the maps in the background with zombies closing in, a red emergency light,
  film grain and drifting ash, a glitching K7 logo and the patch notes on their own card. Your launcher
  updates itself to it.
